title: The people behind
intro: Pittman Woodworks is a family-owned commercial casework shop in North Richland Hills, Texas. Our estimators, drafters, shop crew and installers work as one team, from the first drawing to the final punch list.

highlights.title: Family owned
highlights.text: Owner-led, with a single point of contact on every project.

highlights.title: One roof
highlights.text: Drafting, fabrication and installation all in-house.

highlights.title: Built on referrals
highlights.text: Most of our work comes from returning customers and their recommendations.

highlights.title: North Texas
highlights.text: Based in North Richland Hills, serving DFW and beyond.

storyTitle: A shop built on doing what we say
story: Pittman Woodworks started with a simple idea: commercial clients deserve a cabinet shop that communicates clearly, prices honestly and delivers on schedule.

Led by co-owners Seth Pittman and Eric Jorgenson, we've grown into a full-service casework company serving schools, healthcare facilities, restaurants, retailers and offices across North Texas. We combine the personal attention of a family business with the systems and equipment of a much larger operation.
Most of our projects come from repeat customers and referrals. We think that says more about our work than anything we could write here.

values.title: Honesty
values.text: Clear, truthful communication with every client, at every stage of the job.

values.title: Transparency
values.text: Detailed pricing, material specifications and realistic timelines, so there are no surprises.

values.title: Excellence
values.text: Quality materials, careful craftsmanship and service that earns the next project.
